definitions.primary: Original dataset reference states, physical finger-pad midpoint C, unit closing line u through C; no tolerance rollout actual states.
definitions.cylinder_center: Center of local collision-box bounding bounds, transformed by reference object pose; body-origin alternatives saved.
definitions.dimension: 3D primary; XY horizontal projection computed independently, normalized projected closing axis.
definitions.reconstructed_nominal: Independent positions/rotations from state_reference.hdf5, paired with reference object poses. Separate from source reference-state measurements.
definitions.time: 20Hz reference state i precedes action i; first close index from unchanged original gripper command; no interpolation or time warping.
definitions.phase_windows: Last10 preclose states=0.5s; first6 closing states=0.3s. All grasp attempts separately included.
